After installation, configure a model provider with ./mm configure, then print client configuration with ./mm agent-config --client generic (also codex, claude, cursor, gemini). Local stdio server: ./mm mcp. Requires Git, Bash, Python 3 and uv; installer provisions Python 3.12. Built on MiroFish and OASIS. Model usage can cost money. Generated buyer responses are simulations, not proof of demand; validate with real customer outcomes. The website is a saved example dashboard, not a hosted simulation service.
